title: LIES
description:
> WHY DOES IT STILL LOOK LIKE NONSENSE. THIS COURSE LIED TO ME

WAIT! before you go to yelp, listen. The `xxd` output was just the compressed bytes! Git has a plumbing command to get us the output.
```bash
git cat-file -p <hash>
```
